cause_quote: The redesign set `.agents-home__template-identity` to `display: flex`, added `white-space: nowrap` to the title, and capped the publisher at `max-width: 40%`, so both labels could be ellipsized while sharing the space beside Add.
user_saw: On narrow screens or at larger text sizes, users could see shortened template names and publishers beside Add, making similar templates hard to distinguish.
summary: The fix lets the template name and publisher wrap at the configured text size while keeping Add visible.
reasoning: The parent CSS let the name wrap to two lines and gave the publisher its own line, with a full-width identity block on narrow cards. The redesign made the labels compete for a single line, and the later conversion to shared catalog rows retained that constraint. The fix PR measured clipping in the later row layout, so the earlier onset is supported by the CSS diffs and remains unverified against the same fixture.
